newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Soundview reiterates Intel.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Soundview reiterates Intel.

text.p: -- Soundview Financial analyst Scott Randall reiterated his short- and long-term buy ratings on Intel Corp, saying he remains impressed by the company's long-term growth prospects.
-- He maintained earnings estimates for the 1997 year of $8.75 per share and 1998 at $10.60 with a $180 target price.

-- In comments to his brokerage's sales force, Randall said he was impressed by a technology demonstration Intel held Friday for its next generation of Pentium Pro chips and Microsoft Corp's formal decision to end support for the PowerPC chip, pushing aside a key rival to Intel technology.
-- PowerPC is owned by Apple Computer Inc, Motorola Inc and International Business Machines Corp.

-- Randall said the Klamath trial showed things were on track for Intel's schedlued spring roll-out of the new chip. He said the demonstration showed Klamath running at up to 451 megahertz in ideal test conditions, which Randall said "shows the (Klamath) architecture has a lot of head room in it."
-- The 400-plus megahertz clock speeds is more than double the speed of current top-of-the-line Pentium Pro chips running at 200 megahertz.
